title: gloam theme source
description: Schema for a gloam theme JSON source file (themes/<name>/<name>.json). All 16 output format files are generated from this single source of truth.

name.description: Theme slug — lowercase, no spaces. Must match the containing directory name.

displayName.description: Human-readable theme name shown in VS Code and other UIs.

type.description: Background type — controls VS Code uiTheme selection and light-theme ANSI notes.

background.description: Terminal background color (#RRGGBB). All four semantic tokens must achieve ≥4.5:1 contrast against this value.

tokens.description: The four semantic color tokens. These are the single source of truth for all prompt and syntax colors.

primary.description: Navigation tier — directory path, language badges. Must achieve ≥4.5:1 against background.

accent.description: State/action tier — git branch, prompt character, cursor. Must achieve ≥4.5:1 against background.

muted.description: Chrome tier — username, time, box corners, structural separators. Must achieve ≥4.5:1 against background.

error.description: Exception tier — failed exit status only. Must achieve ≥4.5:1 against background.

ansi.description: 16-color ANSI palette (slots 0–15). Derived from semantic tokens by visual harmony — see ADR-005. Must contain exactly 16 entries.

ui.description: Editor and terminal UI color slots used by VS Code, iTerm2, Alacritty, WezTerm, and other supported targets.

cursor.description: Cursor block fill color. Typically the accent token.

cursorText.description: Text color inside the cursor block. Typically the background.

selectionText.description: Selected text foreground. Typically the foreground token.

bold.description: Bold text color. Typically the foreground or a lighter variant.

link.description: Hyperlink color. Must be palette-derived and distinct from body text.

prompt.description: Starship prompt personality settings. Controls the format string, fill character, time prefix, and prompt symbols in the generated starship.toml.

layout.description: Prompt layout. 'two-line-box' renders a box frame (╭╰─); 'single-line' renders without a frame.

showUsername.description: Whether to show $username on the first prompt line.

fill.description: Fill character between information modules and the time display. Must be at least 1 character. Each theme should use a unique fill character derived from its concept.

timePrefix.description: Character shown before the time and slow command duration. Must be unique across all themes.

successSymbol.description: Prompt character shown on successful command exit (styled fg:accent).

vimSymbol.description: Prompt character shown in Vim normal mode (styled fg:primary).
